metadata.description: s2ar's tools for Claude Code: sym (read the function, not the file) and lens (the screenshot, not the pixels)

plugins.name: sym
plugins.description: Symbol-level code reads for coding agents (CLI + MCP + a Read hook). Keeps whole files out of context.

plugins.name: lens
plugins.description: lens: the screenshot, not the pixels. A whole-image Read over 1024 px comes back downscaled to the size a model reads, with the tokens kept out on the line.
